title: Terms supplied by law or implication
shortTitle: Terms supplied by law or implication
summary: Gap filling supplies a term that the parties’ agreement leaves open, using applicable law or a justified implication from their transaction.
notes: The existence of an omitted term does not always prevent enforcement. Identify the source and limits of the proposed term, the parties’ intention, and whether there is a sufficiently definite agreement to enforce. Northrop and the definiteness cases illustrate different problems; they do not authorize replacing every disagreement with a court’s preferred outcome.
